messages:
Priya (sec-eng): Heads-up — Neptune Systems asked for a consolidated packet for Thursday's security review: RBAC change logs, audit-log exports, KMS envelope unwrap events, vuln triage notes, and an attestation statement. I can assemble but need raw snippets and a short statement about tenant separation.
Tom (infra): I can pull the RBAC history and drift-check outputs. Which window?
Priya (sec-eng): 120 days to be safe. They also want a recent example of a role change requiring dual-approval.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Neptune's checklist: (1) role change trail with approval IDs, (2) KMS envelope unwraps correlated to tenant request IDs, (3) SIEM ingestion evidence (we forward to Splunk), (4) vuln timeline for CVE-2025-0134, and (5) HSM vendor attestation.
Dan (platform): For KMS unwraps we can export CloudHSM logs. Note: redact key material and tenant PII. Example command we use:
```bash
./tools/export_kms_audit.sh --since=2024-11-01 --until=2025-02-28 --format=jsonl --redact-pii > neptune_kms_unwraps.jsonl
```
Tom (infra): RBAC export sample will include actor, target, prev_roles, new_roles, approval_workflow_id. Example row:
```json
{"ts":"2025-01-17T09:22:11Z","actor":"svc-deploy","target":"bob","prev_roles":["viewer"],"new_roles":["deployer"],"approval_workflow_id":"awf_123"}
```
Priya (sec-eng): For SIEM proof include indexing metadata and a sample event with correlation_id but obfuscated tenant id. Dan, can you run a Splunk manifest export for the 120d window?
Dan (platform): Yep. We'll provide a manifest CSV with index, sourcetype, event_count, earliest_ts, latest_ts and a small sample of events.
security-bot: Checklist created: security.packet.neptune.3344556678 (rbac_export, kms_unwraps, siem_manifest, vuln_timeline, hsm_attestation, exec_summary). Assigned: Priya/Tom/Dan. Deadline: 2025-03-06 08:00 UTC.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Neptune compliance might request a vendor-signed attestation. We have a current attestation from our HSM provider; can attach that but they might want a signed statement referencing the export window.
Dan (platform): We can ask the vendor for a stamped attestation, but lead time may be a few days. We will include our recorded attestation and the vendor doc.
Priya (sec-eng): Action items: Tom => RBAC export + diagram; Dan => KMS export + HSM attestation request + SIEM manifest; I => executive summary + redaction checklist + assemble packet. Rebecca => coordinate during the call.
Tom (infra): Starting exports. Will post samples to #eng-archives and DM links.
Priya (sec-eng): Please tag me for redaction edge cases. I will compile a draft and post for review by EOD PT.
Dan (platform): KMS sample uploaded to s3://compliance-evidence/neptune-3344556678/ and shared link.
Tom (infra): RBAC export uploaded to same bucket. DM'd Priya.
Priya (sec-eng): Wrapping up: merging artifacts and running redact script now. Rebecca, I'll hand off the final zip and a short Q&A doc before the call.
Rebecca (customer-sRE): Thanks all, much appreciated :thumbsup:
